audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty framing rested on a fabricated condition: the page repeatedly says Poppy's resists apply 'while grounded'.
audit.why: Riot's Steadfast Presence text is 'Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health.' There is no grounded condition on her own resists — grounding is what SHE applies to YOU when the active stops a dash. The real difficulty driver is that her resists climb as the trade goes long, so extended exchanges get worse for Galio, not better.
audit.corrected: Early is Poppy's on stats; Galio's window is level 3+ on the Steadfast Presence cooldown; from 6 the lane is a roam lane. Extended trades favour her because her passive resists scale with missing health.

audit.why: Spike structure (Poppy: W online, 6, first item; Galio: 2-3, 6, first item) matches the kits. Galio's level-6 spike is the map spike, not a lane spike, and the page already says so.
audit.corrected: Kept; sharpened Galio's 6 to name the Keeper's Verdict channel-cancel as the thing his R and W buy him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent or wrong. (a) Keeper's Verdict is a CHANNEL — Galio's Shield of Durand taunt or a Hero's Entrance landing cancels it. Nowhere on the page. (b) The page claims Steadfast Presence stops Galio's R landing.
audit.why: Riot: Keeper's Verdict — 'Poppy channels a hammer strike'; kit flags include channel. Riot: Steadfast Presence — 'stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.' Hero's Entrance is not a dash (Riot: designates a landing spot, smashes down after a delay), so the R-landing claim is unsupported and was removed rather than reversed.
audit.corrected: Steadfast Presence (20/18/16/14/12s) stops Justice Punch (11/10/9/8/7s) and leaves you grounded and slowed inside Heroic Charge range (14/13/12/11/10s, 475). Your W taunt cancels her Keeper's Verdict channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block named Steadfast Presence as matchup-defining but carried no numbers.
audit.why: Her W is 20s at rank 1 against an 11s Justice Punch — that ratio is the whole lane and it is checkable in the kit file.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the cooldowns block, winCon, wants.you[1] and the level-3 phase.

audit.whatIsWrong: loading line ended with 'Anti-heal if he sustains'.
audit.why: Poppy has no healing in her kit (Iron Ambassador is a shield pickup; nothing in Q/W/E/R heals). The line is a template leftover and pure filler.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes Poppy's resists to her 'passive'. Her passive is Iron Ambassador (buckler throw, shield on pickup); the resists are on Steadfast Presence's passive component.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon slots: P = Iron Ambassador, W = Steadfast Presence.
audit.corrected: Named the resists to Steadfast Presence's passive component throughout.

edits.before: Poppy's Steadfast Presence passive gives her free armor and MR while grounded, so her autos and Q ground-slam out-trade your single ability at level 1 — concede the opener and farm with Q windblasts.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence passively gives her armor and MR that grow as her health drops, so she out-trades you harder the longer level 1 runs — take the first exchange or none, and farm with Winds of War tips.

edits.before: You have one ability and no engage at level 1 while her Steadfast Presence passive gives her bonus armor and MR while grounded — she out-trades your opener.
edits.after: You have one ability and no engage at level 1, and Steadfast Presence's passive armor and MR climb as she loses health — long openers get worse, not better.

edits.before: Bad news up front: Poppy gives Shield of Durand nothing to work with. Your magic-amplified damage reduction is dead weight against her AD autos and physical Q slam, so you can't sponge your way to a win here. At level 1 you have one ability and no engage while her Steadfast Presence passive hands her free armor and MR as long as she stays grounded, so she out-stats your opening trades. Farm with the tip of your Q tornado, don't walk into her Q ground-slam range for autos, and accept you're behind on tempo until your full kit is online.
edits.after: Bad news up front: Poppy gives Shield of Durand little to work with. Your magic-amplified damage reduction is dead weight against her AD autos and physical Hammer Shock, so you can't sponge your way to a win here. At level 1 you have one ability and no engage, and Steadfast Presence's passive armor and MR climb as her health drops, so the longer an exchange runs the worse it gets. Farm with the tip of your Q tornado, stay outside the 430 range of Hammer Shock so she can't slam-and-auto, and accept you're behind on tempo until your full kit is online.

edits.before: This is where Poppy buries the duel. Her Q ground-slam leaves a slow zone and her R, Keeper's Verdict, knocks you back the instant you land — your signature Hero's Entrance teamfight engage gets denied by her ult. Don't try to 1v1 her; her tankiness ignores your AP. Your value is sponging the ENEMY mages and assassins with W, not soaking Poppy. Save your R to peel for your carries or engage their backline from an angle she can't active-W or charge you out of, and let your team handle the Poppy.
edits.after: This is where Poppy buries the duel. Hammer Shock leaves a slow zone and Keeper's Verdict knocks you back the instant you land, so her ult answers your entrance. But that ult is a channel: your W taunt, or an R landing on top of her, cancels it outright — hold one for the wind-up and her 100-second ultimate is gone. Don't 1v1 her; her tank stats shrug off your AP. Your value is sponging the ENEMY mages and assassins with W and peeling, not soaking Poppy — let your team handle her.

notes: Galio's Justice Punch carries a derived 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes' flag in champ-data/_kits/galio.json. Riot's own description is 'Galio will briefly step back and charge, knocking up the first enemy champion he encounters' — no terrain. The flag is a tooltip-parse misfire and it has propagated into _missing-interactions.json as a 'terrain-cuts-retreat' rule on Galio for at least six enemies (sejuani, sett, singed, sion, swain, tahmkench, plus mid/support rows). I did not write any terrain claim anywhere. Recommend suppressing that rule for Galio. Separately, the poppy row of _missing-interactions asserts Shield of Durand and Hero's Entrance both cancel Keeper's Verdict; the W taunt cancel is solid (taunt is hard CC on a channel), the R cancel depends on the landing knockup arriving during the channel, so I phrased it as 'an R landing on top of her'. Also: the FULL layer for this matchup used male pronouns for Poppy throughout — I fixed the ones inside strings I was already rewriting, but breakdown.feeding and several report entries may still read 'him' if other paths are edited later.
